text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Representative Exchange 
Race, El Condor Pasa devoted herself to 
practical combat training.

She whispers her wish: to deliver the joy 
of becoming number one in the world to the 
family and friends who supported her, on 
her own two legs.

The Trainer's office door swings wide 
open, and El Condor Pasa challenges them 
to a showdown in the Representative 
Exchange Race.

It was a declaration of war from El Condor 
Pasa to the Umamusume currently closest to 
the world: <chrname>.
